ScheduleEntry.description:
One pending, already-public docket's next scheduled conference.

A row exists for every docket on the public set whose corpus row is
unresolved and carries a conference it was distributed for. The date is
published as `next_conference` only while it falls on or after the
schedule's `as_of`; once it has passed and the docket has not moved, the
row keeps the date it was distributed for and says why it is no longer a
scheduled date, so a past conference is never shown as upcoming.

distributed_for_conference.description: The corpus `distributed_for_conference`: the date named by the docket's newest 'DISTRIBUTED for Conference of …' entry, as the live channel last read it, whether or not it has passed
distributed_for_conference.title: Distributed For Conference

last_live_polled.description: When the live channel last read this docket — the per-case vintage of `distributed_for_conference`, which `as_of` is not
last_live_polled.title: Last Live Polled

next_conference.description: The conference the docket is distributed for, when it falls on or after `as_of`; null exactly when `stale_reason` is set
next_conference.title: Next Conference

stale_reason.description: Why the row carries no `next_conference`: `conference_passed` (the conference is before `as_of` and the docket shows no newer distribution or a decision yet). Null while the date is still ahead
stale_reason.title: Stale Reason

ScheduleEntry.title: ScheduleEntry

description:
``data/schedule/schedule.json`` — the next scheduled conference, public set only.

Written by the live poll from the corpus it already holds, after each cycle,
for the dockets the repository already discloses under ``data/cases``: it is
enumerated from that committed tree alone and never from a corpus scan, the
same compilation-extent boundary as the scope manifest. Display data for
the public site: it is not a prediction-ledger record (a schedule moves on
every relist), nothing predicts, evaluates or scores on it, and no cell is
provisioned with it. ``skipped`` is set, with no entries, when no corpus was
present.

as_of.description: The UTC day the schedule was built on, which decides whether a conference has passed; null on a skipped build
as_of.title: As Of

entries.description: One entry per pending public docket with a conference it was distributed for, in case_id order
entries.title: Entries

skipped.description: True when no corpus was present; nothing was read
skipped.title: Skipped

title: Schedule
